meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 该技能会为当前项目新增一个零依赖、只读的网页仪表盘：它把任何以 JSON 格式列出资源的命令行工具自动呈现成标签页和表格，并预置 NanoClaw 的 ncl 资源、消息活动图、日志与只读文件查看器。
howto.when: 当请求里提到“添加/安装 clidash”，或要求用命令行工具的 JSON 输出搭一个只读仪表盘时触发；常见于 NanoClaw 项目里想查看分组、消息活动和日志等场景。

say.text: 给项目装 clidash 看板，用默认配置。
say.note: 复制 tools/clidash 并创建默认配置。

say.text: 启动 clidash，确认 ncl 资源能正常列出。
再把 docker 加成一个数据源。
say.note: 可参考配置里的 jsonlines 示例。

howto.what_en: Gives the project a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard: any CLI listing resources as JSON becomes a tab and a table, pre-wired for NanoClaw’s ncl resources, activity, logs, and read-only file viewer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the request mentions adding/installing clidash or asks for a read-only dashboard generated from a CLI’s JSON output, often in NanoClaw projects for groups, activity, or logs.

say_en.text: Add clidash to this project with the default config.
say_en.note: Copies tools/clidash and creates default config.

say_en.text: Start clidash and confirm ncl resources are listed.
Also add docker as another data source.
say_en.note: A jsonlines example is present in the config.
